"Create a highly addictive 2D mobile endless runner game called \"SHADOW RUN: Don't Touch the Light\".

GAMEPLAY:

- The player controls a small glowing shadow character running automatically through a dark futuristic tunnel.
- The player can tap anywhere on the screen to instantly switch between running on the floor and running on the ceiling.
- Avoid deadly lasers, spikes, moving barriers, electric traps and other obstacles.
- Collect glowing energy orbs to increase your score.
- The game gets progressively faster and more difficult over time.

FEATURES:

- Very simple one-finger controls.
- Smooth animations and responsive gameplay.
- Randomly generated obstacle patterns.
- Neon cyberpunk visual style with dark backgrounds and glowing purple, blue and red effects.
- Satisfying sound effects and visual feedback.
- Personal high score system.
- Unlockable character skins using collected energy.
- Game over screen with score, best score and a restart button.
- A beautiful main menu with a PLAY button.

Make the game polished, challenging, extremely fun and easy to understand within 5 seconds.

IMPORTANT: The game must be fully playable, not just a visual prototype. Make sure all buttons and gameplay mechanics actually work.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a polished, fully playable mobile endless runner, “SHADOW RUN: Don’t Touch the Light,” with one-tap gravity switching, obstacles, collectibles, progression, skins, audio, and menus.

## Requirements
- User requested working gameplay and buttons, responsive one-finger controls, progressively harder procedural obstacles, neon visuals, sound effects, persistent high score and energy, unlockable skins, game-over/restart, and a main-menu PLAY button.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a standalone HTML canvas app with inline CSS and JavaScript in `index.html`; no framework or external game engine.
- Persist best score, collected energy, unlocked/equipped skins, and sound preference using `localStorage`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented menu, playable endless runner, gravity switching via tap/click/Space/arrows, hazards, energy orbs, progressive speed/difficulty, collisions, score/best tracking, skin shop, sound toggle and synthesized sound effects.
- Checked JavaScript syntax with Node and launched the page in Playwright. Confirmed menu loads, PLAY starts the game, and tapping the canvas switches lane.
- Saved and inspected game screenshots at `/tmp/opencode/shadow-run-menu.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/shadow-run-game.jpg`.
- Fixed obstacle spawn spacing to count down with elapsed travel distance and added a data-URI favicon.

### Active
- No active edits currently; perform any remaining polish/testing and provide a concise completion summary.

### Blocked

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` for remaining gameplay or responsive UI bugs; optionally recheck browser console and game-over/shop interactions.
2. Finish with a brief summary of the implementation and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/shadow-run-menu.jpg`: Captured menu screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/shadow-run-game.jpg`: Captured gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is newly created.
- Browser verification succeeded using `playwright-cli` after installing Chromium; server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The harness snapshot reported gameplay score and lane switching correctly; the screenshot was saved and inspected.
